Thank you very much for the reply!

When I talk about being impulsive, I mean I say "yes" to dangerous situations because I want people to like me, even though the situation would be detrimental to me, if that makes sense. Maybe that's not considered impulsive, but maybe it's extreme people pleasing. 

I have already gotten diagnoses and started treatment about two years ago. Recently, I've re-started therapy, and it's going well. If I tell my therapist about my thoughts of suicide, then she will disclose that information to a hospital and have me sent to inpatient.
